selection_rule: Separate judgments require genuine reuse and a substantive challenge to the exact scoped claim or a specific unresolved support gap. Adequately supported, unchallenged possibilities and mechanisms are sourced context. No background item is a reviewer Yes or proof of the complete argument.

additional_background.statement: S.1582 bars issuers from paying holders interest or yield solely for holding or using a coin, and this removes one incentive that could otherwise draw money away from bank deposits that support lending. The claim concerns payments by issuers; it does not say all rewards are barred.
additional_background.scope_html: The rule covers payments by issuers. Other firms may offer rewards. This does not establish the size of any effect on bank deposits or loans.
